title: GET /discover/refresh and /discover/{connection}/refresh no longer let a non-admin flush the shared Mondrian schema cache and rebuild every connection

criteria.given: a caller without ROLE_ADMIN calls GET /rest/saiku/{username}/discover/refresh
criteria.then: no connection is refreshed (no cache flush); the current connection list is returned so the cube picker keeps working

criteria.given: a caller without ROLE_ADMIN calls GET /rest/saiku/{username}/discover/{connection}/refresh
criteria.then: the call is refused with 403 and nothing is refreshed
